source_note: With: the CLAUDE.md from one headless /init run (Claude Code 2.1.272, lab config, 15 Sep 2026) on a clean base/frai copy, saved unedited (72 lines; init_run.json is that run). Without: a CLAUDE.md (105 lines: commands, layout, conventions, environment) drafted by Claude from the real base/frai code before the /init output existed, so it could not borrow from it; every command, path and convention in it was checked against package.json scripts and the source. Both files frozen before any run. Hint check against the four hard prompts (h1-h4) and reference patches: the without file names folders and files only (config/, scanners/, eval/, the gate validator) and says nothing about the gate's field parsing, eval thresholds, .env parsing or writing, root option handling, or the scanner's import matching; its options-object example was changed from the scanner's `root` to `Rag.indexDocuments` because h4 passes a directory to the scanner. The /init file stays unedited because the trick is the unedited file. Its overlap with the hard tasks is general layout, not the fixes: validate.ts flags missing, placeholder and non-numeric answers and high-risk tiers without sign-off (h1 area; nothing on label styles, continuation lines or NEEDS HUMAN INPUT), scanner detectors live in scanners/detectors.js and scanCodebase takes a `root` option (h4), Config stores the key in a project .env or ~/.config/frai/config and the root command keeps legacy flags such as --setup through handleCompatibilityOptions (h3 area), gate exit codes are 0/1/2, and `frai gate` spawns frai-gate's CLI. Evidence against /init: https://www.humanlayer.dev/blog/writing-a-good-claude-md and https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.11988 Task set and model changed on 15 Sep 2026 after the pilots (see PROTOCOL): t1, t2, t3 and h2 on Haiku 4.5, both sides.
